The use of analyzers may impact performance:
channels consume data more slowly because they must wait for tokenization to complete. As a result, newly ingested data takes longer to become available for search.
For keyword matching, index creation is also slower since tokenization needs to finish before an index can be built.
: The tokenizer breaks input text into discrete units called tokens. These tokens could be words or phrases, depending on the tokenizer type.
: Filters can be applied to tokens to further refine them, for example, by making them lowercase or removing common words.
Tokenizers support only UTF-8 format. Support for other formats will be added in future releases.
